title: Automated Trajectory Evaluation for Mobile Agents via Step-Level Consequence Reasoning and Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating language-guided mobile agents has recently shifted from rule-based to model-based approaches to achieve scalable and automated assessments. However, existing holistic evaluation paradigms process entire trajectories at once, leading to substantial context overload. Moreover, they primarily focus on task completion while overlooking operational safety. To address these limitations, we introduce CRATE, a novel two-stage VLM-as-judge framework for automated mobile agent evaluation that is compatible with both open- and closed-source models. Leveraging a step-level consequence reasoning mechanism, CRATE independently extracts task-relevant visual clues and infers action-conditioned state changes at each step. The resulting step-level textual evidence is then synthesized through trajectory-level aggregation to deliver an evidence-grounded evaluation of task completion. translated_title: 移动代理的自动化轨迹评估：基于步骤级后果推理与聚合
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.20797v1 公告类型：新 摘要：评估语言引导的移动代理最近已从基于规则的方法转向基于模型的方法，以实现可扩展和自动化的评估。然而，现有的整体评估范式一次性处理整个轨迹，导致显著的上下文过载。此外，它们主要关注任务完成情况，而忽视了操作安全性。为解决这些限制，我们引入了CRATE，一种新颖的两阶段VLM作为评判者的框架，用于自动化移动代理评估，该框架兼容开源和闭源模型。利用步骤级后果推理机制，CRATE独立提取任务相关的视觉线索，并在每一步推断基于动作的状态变化。然后，通过轨迹级聚合综合生成的步骤级文本证据，以提供基于证据的任务完成评估。在此评估方案的基础上，我们进一步扩展了CRATE。
tldr: CRATE提出了一种两阶段VLM评判框架，通过步骤级后果推理和轨迹级聚合，在评估移动代理任务完成度的同时兼顾操作安全性，解决了现有整体评估的上下文过载问题。
en_tdlr: CRATE introduces a two-stage VLM-as-judge framework that leverages step-level consequence reasoning and trajectory-level aggregation to evaluate mobile agents on task completion while addressing operational safety, overcoming context overload in holistic evaluation.
